source: NOAA HRRR native wrfnat hybrid atmosphere and same-cycle wrfprs analysis soil
time_policy: Native atmosphere follows each valid time; terrain and nine-node soil come from the same-cycle analysis pressure product.
member_policy: HRRR is deterministic; no member identity exists
input_identity: dynamic file paths and SHA-256 values are owned by gpuwm-mapped-composition-inputs-v1
aerosol_semantics: NOAA operational HRRR parm/conus/hrrr_vtable declares QNWFA and QNIFA in kg-1 on hybrid surface 105, using NCEP local parameters 0/13/193 and 0/13/192. These records retain PMTF/PMTC display labels in public indexes; the operational Vtable, not those particulate-mass labels, owns their number-per-mass meaning.
aerosol_missing_policy: NOAA operational HRRR parm/conus/hrrr_METGRID.TBL declares nearest_neighbor+four_pt+average_4pt with fill_missing=0 for QNWFA and QNIFA. Source masks remain intact until the horizontal interpolation chain exhausts its finite neighboring donors; only then is a missing target filled with zero.

runtime_vegetation.time_policy: source cycle analysis is broadcast as the initial vegetation fraction
